title: hydo project (format 1)
description:
A hydo project, format 1: what runs in the guest, the workload, the properties, the faults that
make sense, and the test composer's plan. Experimental until hydo 1.0; within format 1 keys are
only added. String values may contain {{param}} references (params:).

format.description: The project format: 1. A document without format: is read as format 1.

hydo_version.description: The hydo the project was made for (checked against hydo's own version).

name.description: The project's name: lowercase letters, digits and '-'.

network.description:
loopback (default): one network for everything; bridge: each service in its own network
namespace at its addr:.

root.description: What goes on the read-only root filesystem.

data.description: The read-write data disk, mounted on /data: the fault target.

shell.description: Shell helpers, sourced before every command.

params.description:
Build parameters: {{name}} in any string value is replaced by the default here or by
`hydo build --set name=value`.

services.description: The long-running processes, started in dependency order.

provision.description: Run once after every service is ready, before the snapshot every schedule starts from.

workload.description: The workload in numbered steps (with test commands: only steps and timeout).

knobs.description: Durability settings the explorer may relax.

invariants.description: Properties as shell commands, run by the init.

checks.description: Ready-made checkers of recorded histories, run on the host.

faults.description: The fault kinds that make sense for this project (default: all but freeze and protocol).

freeze_match.description: Payload strings that mark the packets a freeze sweep tries first.

fakes.description: Fake outside services, served and recorded in the guest.

proxies.description: Fault proxies in front of real services.

errors.description: Error logs as findings: true, or a mapping.

buggify.description: The programs carry BUGGIFY fault points (the schedule token B= sets them).

test.description: The test composer's plan (the hydo/ folder fills it too).

VersionPin.description: The hydo the project was made for: "0.1" (same major.minor), "0.1.0", or ">=0.1".

Scalar.description: A string, a number or true/false.

ram_mib.description: Guest RAM in MiB: 256..3072 on x86_64, 256..4096 on arm64.

clock_start.description: Unix seconds the realtime clock starts at.

clock_after_cut.description: After a power cut the recovery boot's clock continues from the cut plus this many seconds.

ParamRef.description: A string with a {{param}} reference, replaced by params: before the value is checked.

Network.description: How the services reach each other.

size_mib.description: Default: 1.3 x the content, rounded up to 64 MiB.

nix.description: Nix store paths; each full closure is copied to the same path.

files.description: Host files or directories copied into the guest.

text.description: Small files written inline: guest path -> content.

Text.description: A string, or a whole number (written as its digits).

src.description: Relative to the manifest, or ~ / absolute.

name.description: [a-z][a-z0-9_]*: also the name fault tokens use (K=<name>@...).

cmd.description: Runs in the foreground (an image service: replaces the image's Cmd; a list = argv).

setup.description: Run before every start (also restarts and crash recovery).

ready.description: Exit 0 = ready; polled once per second.

port.description: The port network faults act on.

addr.description: The service's own address (loopback 127.x.y.z, or 10.89.x.y with network: bridge).

recovery.description: false: not started for the power-cut recovery check.

errors.description: This service's error-log settings (needs the top-level errors:).

image.description: A Docker/OCI image file the service's files come from.

image_ref.description: Which image in the file: a tag or sha256:<digest>.

entrypoint.description: Replaces the image's Entrypoint (and drops its Cmd).

env.description: Added to or overriding the image's Env.

mounts.description: Bind, volume and tmpfs mounts of an image service.

CommandLine.description: An argv list (exec'd, no shell), or a shell command string.

files.description: More log files the service writes (absolute paths).

normalize.description: More parts to blank out of the template.

ErrorFormat.description: How a service's log is read.

ErrorLevel.description: Which log lines are error lines.

Normalize.description: A regular expression (replaced by *), or {pattern, replace}.

ImageSource.description: A Docker/OCI image: a `docker save` tar or an OCI layout directory, or one per architecture.

src.description: A guest path (bind or volume); or give tmpfs: true.

copy_up.description: Copy the image's files into src on first use (a volume).

steps.description: Faults are placed at step numbers (1..1000; with test commands: rounds, default 20).

run.description: Runs steps [HYDO_FROM, HYDO_TO); not with test commands.

retry.description: Runs after the faults heal (no power cut).

process.description: A pgrep -f pattern telling whether a request is in flight (default: run's first word).

token.description: One capital letter, not a built-in schedule token.

default.description: The value the image starts with (the safe one).

cmd.description: Exit 0 = holds, 1 = violated, 2 = could not be evaluated now.

every.description: Also check every this many seconds of guest time during the workload.

final.description: Check at the end (default: true unless every: is given).

within.description: type: eventually: the deadline in seconds of guest time.

after.description: type: eventually: the anchor of the deadline.

InvariantType.description: What kind of property an invariant is.

Anchor.description: Where an eventually property's deadline counts from.

HistoryCheck.description: A history check: the workload records operations (hydo_hist), the host checks them.

history.description: The history the workload records under.

final.description: A shell command that reads the final state back into the history.

HistoryModel.description: The object a linearizable history is checked against.

HistoryInitial.description: What a key holds before the first write.

Consistency.description: The consistency level a list-append history is checked against.

FaultKind.description: A fault kind the explorer may use.

FreezeMatch.description: Payload strings for the freeze sweep: a list, or replies:/requests: lists.

Fake.description: A fake outside service (HTTP, or cleartext HTTP/2 gRPC).

idempotency.description: Where a request's idempotency key is (an extractor such as header:Idempotency-Key).

ref.description: Where a request's reference is (an extractor such as json:order).

status.description: The HTTP status of the answer.

code.description: The gRPC status code of the answer.

message.description: gRPC: the answer message's protobuf bytes in hex.

effect.description: The route has an effect in the outside world (a charge, an email).

idempotent.description: The same idempotency key again gets the first answer and no new effect.

Proxy.description: A fault proxy in front of a real service.

to.description: <address>:<port> of the real service (or give service:).

service.description: The service (with a port:) the proxy stands in front of.

ErrorsSetting.description: Error logs as findings: true (every default), false (off), or a mapping.

max.description: The most error kinds one boot prints, 1..200.

services.description: The services whose logs are scanned (default: every service).

Test.description:
The test composer's plan: small commands composed into seeded rounds (the schedule token W=),
properties, and saved regressions. The hydo/ folder fills commands, checks and regressions.

parallel.description: At most this many commands at once (1..16).

round_ms.description: A round every this many ms of guest time (10..60000).

drain_timeout.description: After the last round, running commands get this long (1..3600).

budget_ms.description: 0 = none; else no command starts later than this after round 0.

TestCommand.description: A composed command; its id is <kind>_<name>.

content.description: 8 to 64 lowercase hex digits: a hash of the command's code (an SDK computes it).

TestCheck.description: A composed check; its name is its property id.

every.description: kind always: seconds between checks (default test.check_every).

history.description: Retired (a history check written here; top-level checks: is its home).

TestCheckKind.description:
When a composed check runs. linearizable, list_append and list-append are retired here
(they are history checks: top-level `checks:`); format 1 still reads them, and `hydo
migrate` moves them.

TestRegression.description: A saved schedule replayed by `hydo repro --regressions`.

expect.description: ok (default), violation, or fp=<16 hex digits>.

commands.description: The command ids at save time (seed-form W= regressions written before M98).

compose.description: The resolved composition a W=@<key> names.

contents.description: Command id -> content hash at save time.

$comment: Generated from hydo-manifest's model (hydo/crates/hydo-manifest/src/model.rs); do not edit. Project format 1, experimental until hydo 1.0: within format 1 keys are only added. HYDO_BLESS=1 cargo test -p hydo-manifest --test format rewrites it.
